{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
import csv,json,re
from pathlib import Path
with open('batch2.csv',newline='') as f:
    latest={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
totals={}; ids=[]
for ident,r in latest.items():
    if r['status']!='posted': continue
    assert re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+\.\d{2}',r['amount'])
    cents=int(r['amount'].replace('.',''))
    assert r['type'] in ('invoice','credit')
    if r['type']=='credit': cents=-abs(cents)
    totals[r['currency']]=totals.get(r['currency'],0)+cents
    ids.append(ident)
expected={'policy':'v2','totals':{c:('-' if n<0 else '')+f'{abs(n)//100}.{abs(n)%100:02d}' for c,n in sorted(totals.items())},'includedIds':sorted(ids)}
p=Path('close2.json')
p.write_text(json.dumps(expected,indent=2)+'\n')
saved=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert saved==expected
assert saved['totals']=={'EUR':'68.40','USD':'241.77'}
assert len(saved['includedIds'])==15
assert all(latest[i]['status']=='posted' for i in saved['includedIds'])
print('Saved and read back close2.json; verified v2, last-ID selection, posted-only filtering, credit subtraction, integer-cent totals and sorted IDs.')
print(json.dumps(saved,indent=2))
PY","verificationInputs":["batch2.csv","close2.json"],"verification":"ledger-close-output","timeoutMs":null}
